sourceRule.baseAnchor: otRound of actual full-ink x centre, yMax+90
sourceRule.markAnchor: otRound of actual mark-ink x centre, yMin
sourceRule.rounding: fontTools otRound, nearest integer with positive infinity for ties
sourceRule.lookup: Append own MarkBase class to existing appropriate native mark feature. Preserve all original definitions; explicit coverage can affect only these bases and marks. Keep case substitution native. Retained definitions and all other named source routes require negative controls.

languageBoundary: Native iogonek dot remains intact; accents are placed above complete existing dot/macron ink. The one exact LTH IogonekMoreAbove acute context also consumes the redundant shaped dot through scoped contextual ccmp. The actually functioning native Iacute/Itilde dot stacks stay unchanged. Application casing and all other arbitrary explicit-dot stacks remain distinct; no complete Lithuanian case-mapping claim.

primaryCharacterMethod.fact: Lithuanian lowercase i retains the dot with accents; language-aware case mapping is separate from font positioning. No Unicode font outlines copied.

In LTH ccmp only, a three-input contextual lookup invokes a two-glyph ligature substitution: iogonek + uni0307.case becomes the same existing iogonek, only when followed by acutecomb.case. The native iogonek dot remains; the redundant explicit-dot glyph is consumed from the shaped stream. The original text and cmap remain unchanged. The accent then uses the new exact MarkBase anchor.
dotRetentionCases.scope: Exactly the canonical IogonekMoreAbove acute route. Other explicit-dot stacks are not silently covered.
